title: One Picture Book Two Vol 55: Les pains du désir

description.main: Photographs of the "breads of desire", bread sculptures that communities in northern Marseille kneaded with Ilaria Turba between 2018 and 2022.
description.extended:
Photographs of the "breads of desire", more than a hundred bread sculptures that communities in northern Marseille kneaded with Ilaria Turba and loaded with their wishes.

Turba worked in northern Marseille from 2018 to 2022, drawing on the Mediterranean tradition of ritual breads. From 2022 the breads travelled through Italy and ended in Sardinia, where those traditions are still practised. There, in 2024, a collective rite burned them to a fine black powder. Les pains du désir records that journey in 17 duotone plates. It is number 55 in Nazraeli Press's One Picture Book Two series, made in collaboration with Micamera in an edition of 500 numbered copies, each with a signed 5x7 inch print.

Turba (b. 1978, Italy) is a multidisciplinary artist who works through workshops and participatory projects with communities, using photography, video, installation, and performance. She was associated artist at Le ZEF, Marseille's national theatre, from 2018 to 2021, and showed Le désir de regarder loin at Manifesta 13 and at Mucem in 2021. Her monograph JEST (Peperoni Books, 2016) is included in 10x10 Photobooks' How We See: Photobooks by Women.
